verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say that connecting GitHub is how it reads your code and how an agent opens a pull request against it. They also describe the workflow: an agent works in your repository checkout, claims approved tasks, and opens PRs from your GitHub account. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the GitHub connection setup and permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Connecting GitHub is how Foreloop reads your code, and how an agent opens a pull request against it.
That agent asks Foreloop for approved tasks in that repository, claims one, does the work, and opens a pull request from your GitHub account.
Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.
